Place.title: Place
Place.description: A visited or wishlist restaurant, lokanta, cafe, pastane, büfe, bar, bakery, or bistro shared publicly for reading with author attribution, product tags, location area, optional coordinates, and aggregated star/price ratings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the place.

visibility.description: Visibility scope ('shared' for public visited places, 'private' for per-user wishlist).

visitStatus.description: Whether the place has been visited (shared) or is on the user's private wishlist.

cuisineType.description: Comma-separated summary of product or cuisine specialties.

cuisineTypes.description: List of up to 6 selected product/cuisine specialties (each max 40 chars).

locationArea.description: District, neighborhood, or region name (e.g., Buca, Kemeraltı, Kadıköy).

promoUrl.description: Optional promotional or Instagram link URL for the place.

coverImage.description: Optional compressed JPEG cover image data URL.

latestComment.description: Most recent review comment or wishlist note summary.

ratingSum.description: Sum of all review star ratings.

avgPriceRating.description: Optional average price rating from 0 to 5.

priceRatingCount.description: Optional count of reviews that included a price rating.

priceRatingSum.description: Optional sum of price ratings across reviews.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: A rating, comment, author attribution, and optional compressed photos for a shared place.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the review author.

authorName.description: Display name of the review author (non-PII).

priceRating.description: Optional integer price rating between 1 and 5.

photos.description: Up to 2 compressed JPEG image data URLs.

UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: Per-user private preference document storing hidden wishlist place IDs.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

hiddenPlaceIds.description: Bounded list of hidden wishlist place IDs (max 500).

/places/{placeId}.description: Shared community list of visited places readable by all visitors (including unauthenticated first-time users) and writable by verified signed-in users.

/places/{placeId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Reviews, ratings, author names, and optional compressed photos on a shared place.

/users/{userId}/wishlist/{placeId}.description: Private per-user wishlist (Gidilecekler) accessible solely by the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Private per-user preferences such as hidden wishlist entries.

/users/{userId}/places/{placeId}.description: Legacy per-user private places collection retained for one-click migration to the shared list.

/users/{userId}/places/{placeId}/reviews.description: Legacy per-user private reviews retained for one-click migration to the shared list.
